estimates.assumptions: 500g dry macaroni (standard elbow or similar); ~370 kcal, 13g protein, 1.6g fat per 100g uncooked
2 US cups (480ml) chicken stock; assumes standard low-sodium broth ~10 kcal, 2g protein, 0.5g fat per cup
1/2 US cup (120ml) heavy cream; ~340 kcal and 36g fat per 100ml, scaled to volume
1 standard fajita seasoning packet (~30-35g); typical commercial mix values
3 medium diced chicken breasts ~450g raw boneless skinless total; ~100 kcal, 21g protein, 2.2g fat per 100g raw
2 tbsp olive oil (all absorbed/used in frying); 120 kcal and 14g fat per tbsp
1 small onion (~70g) finely diced; raw values
2 medium red bell peppers (~240g total) finely diced; raw values
1 cup (100g) shredded cheddar cheese; standard values
small handful chopped parsley for garnish (~10g); negligible calories
